main.description: Sets a role's badge to an uploaded image. The bytes are uploaded to the community's own repo, which is why this goes through the AppView: a space record must reference a blob living in the repo that holds the record. Replaces whatever badge was there before. Use social.colibri.beta.role.update with removeBadge to clear it.

community.description: The community the role belongs to.

input.description: The raw image bytes, at most 256 KB. The content type must be one of image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif or image/webp, and is sniffed rather than trusted.

role.description: The role with the new badge resolved.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: The request is missing, malformed, or unverifiable service auth.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller lacks the role.manage permission.

errors.name: CommunityNotFound
errors.description: No community exists at the given DID.

errors.name: RoleNotFound
errors.description: No role exists at the given record key.

errors.name: RoleProtected
errors.description: The role is marked protected and cannot be modified.

errors.name: RoleHierarchy
errors.description: The role is at or above the caller's highest role position.

errors.name: UnsupportedImage
errors.description: The bytes are not one of the accepted image types.

errors.name: CredentialsUnavailable
errors.description: The AppView cannot act as the community because its stored credentials are missing or unusable.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: A PDS or third-party call the AppView depends on failed.
